title: Operation Bluebird as the first MKUltra

tellings.quote: >> Well, Operation Bluebird was preMK Ultra. >> Yes. Yes, it was. It was the first MK Ultra.

plain: Operation Bluebird, a CIA programme of the early 1950s, came before MKUltra, the CIA's later and better-known programme of mind-control experiments, and in effect was "the first MK Ultra." Michels says Bluebird "was preMK Ultra" in a conversation with the writer Peter Levenda, and the reply agrees: "Yes, it was. It was the first MK Ultra." The point is that the CIA's work on the mind started earlier than the famous name suggests.
